facts.text: It was orbited by the moon Pantora, which was long believed to be the only inhabited world in the system.

facts.text: A desolate planet covered in ice wastelands, tors, and snowy canyons, Orto Plutonia, also sometimes just referred to as Orto, was located in the Sujimis sector's Pantora system, at the edge of the Outer Rim Territories close to Wild Space.

evidence.quote: A desolate planet covered in ice wastelands, tors, and snowy canyons, Orto Plutonia, also sometimes just referred to as Orto, was located in the Sujimis sector's Pantora system, at the edge of the Outer Rim Territories close to Wild Space.

facts.text: The planet maintained a breathable atmosphere as well as a frigid climate, and orbited a single star.

evidence.quote: The planet maintained a breathable atmosphere as well as a frigid climate, and orbited a single star.

facts.text: Far from any major trade routes, Orto Plutonia itself was rare to visits, with its moon Pantora serving as the center of political life in the sector.

evidence.quote: Far from any major trade routes, Orto Plutonia itself was rare to visits, with its moon Pantora serving as the center of political life in the sector.

facts.text: In 21 BBY, a force of Republic clone troopers under the leadership of Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Captain Rex landed on Orto Plutonia to investigate the disappearance of a local clone trooper force.

evidence.quote: In 21 BBY, a force of Republic clone troopers under the leadership of Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Captain Rex landed on Orto Plutonia to investigate the disappearance of a local clone trooper force.

facts.text: Believing that there was no sentient life on Orto Plutonia, Chi Cho declared to the Republic leaders that, since it was within the boundaries of the Pantora system, Plutonia was technically considered Pantoran territory.

evidence.quote: Believing that there was no sentient life on Orto Plutonia, Chi Cho declared to the Republic leaders that, since it was within the boundaries of the Pantora system, Plutonia was technically considered Pantoran territory.

facts.text: A search of the local area revealed that both Republic and Separatist troops had been destroyed, raising suspicion of a third party being involved.

evidence.quote: A search of the local area revealed that both Republic and Separatist troops had been destroyed, raising suspicion of a third party being involved.

facts.text: Further investigation led the Jedi to meet the Talz, a sentient species native to the moon, who had destroyed the forces from both sides in self-defense.

evidence.quote: Further investigation led the Jedi to meet the Talz, a sentient species native to the moon, who had destroyed the forces from both sides in self-defense.

facts.text: The Talz chieftain, Thi-Sen, asked that the Galactic Republic leave them in peace and withdraw all presence from Orto Plutonia.

evidence.quote: The Talz chieftain, Thi-Sen, asked that the Galactic Republic leave them in peace and withdraw all presence from Orto Plutonia.

facts.text: However, Chi Cho refused to accept the Talz as a sentient species and declared Plutonia as sovereign Pantoran property, provoking a war.

evidence.quote: However, Chi Cho refused to accept the Talz as a sentient species and declared Plutonia as sovereign Pantoran property, provoking a war.

facts.text: Afterwards, Chi Cho and his escort were ambushed by a Talz war party, forcing them to fight.

evidence.quote: Afterwards, Chi Cho and his escort were ambushed by a Talz war party, forcing them to fight.

facts.text: The Republic forces led by Rex, although reluctant to involve themselves in the war, defended Cho from the attackers.

evidence.quote: The Republic forces led by Rex, although reluctant to involve themselves in the war, defended Cho from the attackers.

facts.text: Following a drawn-out skirmish, Chairman Cho was severely weakened by a spear in his back.

evidence.quote: Following a drawn-out skirmish, Chairman Cho was severely weakened by a spear in his back.

facts.text: Later on the war, soldiers of the Galactic Marines fought a successful campaign on the planet sometime before the their deployment to Mygeeto.

evidence.quote: Later on the war, soldiers of the Galactic Marines fought a successful campaign on the planet sometime before the their deployment to Mygeeto.

facts.text: During the Galactic Civil War, Talz warriors formed a resistance to the Galactic Empire on Orto Plutonia, maximizing their environmental skills to fight an insurgency the Galactic Empire.

evidence.quote: During the Galactic Civil War, Talz warriors formed a resistance to the Galactic Empire on Orto Plutonia, maximizing their environmental skills to fight an insurgency the Galactic Empire.

facts.text: Orto Plutonia was a desolate icy planet in the Pantora system, home to the native Talz and a number of narglatches.

evidence.quote: Orto Plutonia was a desolate icy planet in the Pantora system, home to the native Talz and a number of narglatches.

facts.text: It was considered a protectorate of the orbiting moon Pantora until the Clone Wars, when the Talz inhabitants were granted political supremacy by the Pantoran Assembly following a brief conflict with Galactic Republic forces.

evidence.quote: It was considered a protectorate of the orbiting moon Pantora until the Clone Wars, when the Talz inhabitants were granted political supremacy by the Pantoran Assembly following a brief conflict with Galactic Republic forces.

facts.text: Orto Plutonia had long been a protectorate of the nearby Pantoran moon, after Pantoran scouts searched the world and declared it uninhabited.

evidence.quote: Orto Plutonia had long been a protectorate of the nearby Pantoran moon, after Pantoran scouts searched the world and declared it uninhabited.

facts.text: They had missed the Talz population, which lived in the ice canyons in villages carved out of the ice walls, filled with huts made from animal skins pulled over bone-frames.

evidence.quote: They had missed the Talz population, which lived in the ice canyons in villages carved out of the ice walls, filled with huts made from animal skins pulled over bone-frames.

facts.text: The Talz lived a simple existence, somehow subsisting off the harsh environment, and using the native narglatch cats as mounts and protection.

evidence.quote: The Talz lived a simple existence, somehow subsisting off the harsh environment, and using the native narglatch cats as mounts and protection.

facts.text: At the time of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the demands for forbidden narglatch-pets from Orto Plutiona was higher than ever.

evidence.quote: At the time of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the demands for forbidden narglatch-pets from Orto Plutiona was higher than ever.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, the Pantoran Assembly requested that the Republic establish an outpost on Orto Plutonia to serve as an advanced warning station for any Separatist incursions.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, the Pantoran Assembly requested that the Republic establish an outpost on Orto Plutonia to serve as an advanced warning station for any Separatist incursions.

facts.text: To that end, the Republic established Glid Station, a clone trooper outpost built within a massive ice spire.

evidence.quote: To that end, the Republic established Glid Station, a clone trooper outpost built within a massive ice spire.

facts.text: The Separatists too established a temporary base in the ice, and all this activity aggravated the Talz.

evidence.quote: The Separatists too established a temporary base in the ice, and all this activity aggravated the Talz.

facts.text: When the Separatists discovered the Talz, they attacked them, but the Talz fought back.

evidence.quote: When the Separatists discovered the Talz, they attacked them, but the Talz fought back.

facts.text: Glid Station got caught in the middle of the conflict, which ended in the Talz slaughter of all Separatists and Republic personnel on the planet.

evidence.quote: Glid Station got caught in the middle of the conflict, which ended in the Talz slaughter of all Separatists and Republic personnel on the planet.

facts.text: The Republic sent a task force to investigate, led by Jedi Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi, assisted by a squad of clone cold assault troopers.

evidence.quote: The Republic sent a task force to investigate, led by Jedi Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi, assisted by a squad of clone cold assault troopers.

facts.text: Cho believed that the Separatists had attacked Glid Station, but the Jedi investigated the disappearance of their troopers and discovered the Talz village.

evidence.quote: Cho believed that the Separatists had attacked Glid Station, but the Jedi investigated the disappearance of their troopers and discovered the Talz village.

facts.text: When it became an apparent that Orto Plutonia had a native population, Cho at first refused to believe it, and then later declared war to wipe out the Talz and keep the planet under Pantoran control.

evidence.quote: When it became an apparent that Orto Plutonia had a native population, Cho at first refused to believe it, and then later declared war to wipe out the Talz and keep the planet under Pantoran control.

facts.text: She withdrew the Republic and Pantoran presence from the world, leaving the Talz free to live their quiet life in their ice canyon villages.

evidence.quote: She withdrew the Republic and Pantoran presence from the world, leaving the Talz free to live their quiet life in their ice canyon villages.

facts.text: Years later, about one year before the Battle of Yavin, bounty hunters Bossk and Boba Fett traveled across the inhospitable surface of Orto Plutonia on a particularly difficult job.
